text:
Hello, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d like to help improve the visibility and organic traffic of your Romanian law firm client’s website.

I have 5 years of experience working with data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’m comfortable using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets to turn raw information into clear, actionable recommendations. While my background is centered on data work, the same structured approach is very valuable in SEO: identifying patterns, evaluating performance, prioritizing opportunities, and tracking what actually moves rankings and traffic.

For this role, I would focus on the core SEO tasks you outlined: keyword research, on-page optimization, website analysis, competitor analysis, and reporting. I’m detail-oriented and data-driven, which helps when reviewing search terms, assessing content gaps, analyzing page-level performance, and organizing insights into practical next steps. I also understand the importance of making recommendations that are grounded in evidence rather than assumptions.

I’m comfortable working with performance data and building reports that make it easier to see what is working and what needs improvement. That means I can help monitor SEO progress, highlight trends, and support decisions around content optimization, internal linking, metadata improvements, and other on-site opportunities. I can also help structure reporting so the results are easy to understand and act on.

I would be glad to contribute a careful, analytical approach to your client’s SEO efforts and support the work needed to strengthen their online presence. If needed, I can adapt quickly to your preferred workflow and reporting style.

One question I have is: will the SEO work focus mainly on Romanian-language pages, or will there also be multilingual optimization involved?
